I added a 0.25s sleep after each request in `tests/test_payments.py`, which keeps the loop at about 4 requests per second, under the sandbox's 5 per second limit. I didn't run the test, so I haven't confirmed the CI flake is gone.

The interval is a `CALL_INTERVAL_S` constant at the top of the file, so it's easy to adjust. The sleep comes after every call, including the last one, which adds a quarter second to the test's total runtime.

I also saved a note about the 5 requests per second limit to project memory, so future integration tests against the sandbox know to throttle.
